name: Corian 2 in. x 2 in. Solid Surface Countertop Sample in Bisque
description: With innovative designs and an enduring color palette, Corian solid surface countertops will make your space. Renowned for adaptability, sensorial qualities, durability and cleanliness, Corian has ably met the challenges of modern living. Corian solid surface countertops offer endless benefits and survive the impact, nicks and cuts that can occur with daily wear and tear. Solid surface is a hygienic surface that prevents dirt and stains from penetrating the material. If you want to make a statement, use Corian as your voice. Color: Bisque.
